units: Selected factual annotations, no exhaustive event count
note: Original paraphrases with primary citations. Coordinates approximate named city/region anchors, not footprints. A date may mark a reporting cutoff rather than the onset of an event; the card says which.

items.title: Displacement inside Ukraine
items.text: UNHCR’s year-end 2025 emergency impact report estimates 3.7 million internally displaced people in Ukraine. Kyiv anchors the national estimate, not a count for the city.

items.title: Two measures of displacement
items.text: The same emergency report gives 5.9 million refugees worldwide. This operational estimate differs from the 5.224 million in the annual population series used here; definitions, coverage and revisions differ.
